<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_char_pos(seg):
    red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] >= 50]
    if not red_nodes:
        return None
    all_rows, all_cols = [], []
    for n in red_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_rows.append(p[0])
            all_cols.append(p[1])
    return (min(all_rows), max(all_rows), min(all_cols), max(all_cols))

# Current position
pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
print(f"Current: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")

# Go DOWN to Position E

pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
cells = last_action_result['executed_actions'][0]['animation']['total_cells_changed']
print(f"DOWN: cells={cells}, rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")

# Explore from Position E
for direction in ['UP', 'DOWN', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT']:
    result = action([direction])
    pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
    cells = last_action_result['executed_actions'][0]['animation']['total_cells_changed']
    print(f"  {direction}: cells={cells}, rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
    if cells > 5:  # Moved
        # Go back
        if direction == 'UP':
            result = action(['DOWN'])
        elif direction == 'DOWN':
            result = action(['UP'])
        elif direction == 'LEFT':
            result = action(['RIGHT'])
        elif direction == 'RIGHT':
            result = action(['LEFT'])
        pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
        print(f"    back: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")

def get_char_pos(seg):
    red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] >= 50]
    if not red_nodes:
        return None
    all_rows, all_cols = [], []
    for n in red_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_rows.append(p[0])
            all_cols.append(p[1])
    return (min(all_rows), max(all_rows), min(all_cols), max(all_cols))
